summary_en: 1,047,600 shares to be cancelled effective 2026-08-25. Post-cancellation issued shares: 17,999,300. Represents 5.5% of pre-cancellation outstanding.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: MegaChips Corporation announced on 2026-08-06 the cancellation of 1,047,600 treasury shares, representing 5.5% of pre-cancellation issued shares outstanding. The cancellation was resolved by the board on 2026-02-06 and will take effect on 2026-08-25 under the Companies Act (Article 178). Post-cancellation, issued shares will total 17,999,300. The shares to be cancelled represent the full amount of treasury stock acquired pursuant to the board resolution dated 2026-02-06.
